title: Admissible-modification projection and coefficient exchange data
statement: Use the full-support blowup category and site projection data of [def-per-admissible-modification-limit-site-data]. Given the common open embeddings $j_J:U\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Bl}_J(A)$, the finite-stage coefficient functor is $p_J^{-1}i_J^{-1}R^qj_{J*}$; its domination transition is the canonical derived pullback/exchange map, with the identity inverse image removed by its canonical comparison. More generally the same formula defines the finite-stage exchange for a commutative square of opens, blowups and closed fibres with a specified comparison of projection functors. Define the canonical cohomology pullback by the derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction unit and global-section composition comparison. Finally, for the adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] of a henselian pair [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], use the extended ideal, spectrum map, inverse-image open and its restriction map. These are definitions of data and maps, with no assertion that the limit presentation or the open embeddings exist. Here affine blowups, base change, etale sheaves, inverse and direct images and cohomology use [def-nagata-affine-blowup], [def-pc-base-change], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and affine spectra use [def-weil-affine-spectrum].
